title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
key_facts: Cloudflare announced a Web Search API, offered through its AI Gateway (its control layer for managing and tracking AI apps).
Launch search partners are Ceramic.ai, Exa and Linkup.
The aim is to let AI agents search the live web for fresh information instead of guessing page addresses.
Cloudflare says its partners have committed to its crawler standards: a verified crawler, respect for site owners' bot rules, and a link to the crawled source in every result.
Search calls show up in AI Gateway logs and use AI Gateway credits; Cloudflare says it charges the partners' list API prices with no markup.
Cloudflare says it will mark which partners support Zero Data Retention, and users can bring their own keys.
Developers can call it through a standard REST endpoint or a Cloudflare Workers binding; Cloudflare says built-in server tools are coming soon.
quote_evidence: Today, we’re announcing Cloudflare’s partnership with web search providers to bring you grounded intelligence via AI Gateway.
We’re kicking off this launch with our partners from Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup.
We also offer web search directly at list API pricing from our partners, without any additional markup.
why_it_matters_hint: Gives developers a ready-made way to feed live web information to AI agents, with logging, billing and crawler rules handled in one place.
event_date: 2 Oct 2026 (the post says "today"; feed date 2 Oct 2026)
notes: Company announcement on its own blog (Birthday Week); benefits and partner compliance are Cloudflare's own claims. No usage or customer numbers given.
